title: Official editor frontend selection
summary: Select verified Official workspace/v2 assets independently of creator layers, honoring latest config and Registry state; absence permits the Gateway's App renderer.

replaceability.why: The adapter and layering machinery are the Host foundation. If this machinery could be replaced by a creator layer, automatic fallback to the original could not be guaranteed. The Lucs carried by open protocols have their own replacement classes.
replaceability.decided: Acrab, self-Luc spec v0.3, 2026-10-18; interface charter rule 6, 2026-10-22

reach.notes: Trusted Host machinery, not authority granted to a Luc. Package calls remain bounded by their resolved permissions, Host APIs and editable scope.

operations.name: official_frontend

output.description: LucFrontend dataclass or None. Files map relative asset names to bytes; identity, origin, native_api and manifest_sha256 identify the verified candidate.

operations.notes: No deadline. Re-verifies selected Official set and frontend pin. Stored-channel failure falls back to bundled set. Does not apply creator layers. Disabled or invalid frontend returns None.

operations.name: LucFrontend.describe
operations.notes: No deadline is enforced by this synchronous Python seam. Retrying a read observes the current state.

operations.name: LucFrontend.enabled_for
operations.notes: No deadline is enforced by this synchronous Python seam. Retrying a read observes the current state.

operations.name: LucFrontend.file

output.description: bytes; missing key raises FileNotFoundError, not LucError.

operations.notes: No deadline. Exact selected asset lookup; content_type uses mimetypes and defaults to application/octet-stream.

invariants.text: Only Lumeri's Official workspace frontend for the requested product can provide these assets.
The selector compiles the original Official artifact, not an activation-profile or local-folder layer.

break: The operation rejects invalid input, integrity, authority or binding state as described by its operation.

conformance.notes: Existing tests listed here were inspected, not run for this documentation task. The area checker validates the contract files; it does not exercise runtime behavior.

known_deviations.text: The Gateway's frontend selector uses safe_mode=False and does not consult the interaction relay's safe-mode environment switch here. Recovery behavior for the page shell is separate from Worker package recovery.
